SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT CS.*, IIC.INDEXID, IIC.CATEGORY, C.CODENAME, IIC.REMARK, II.INDEXNAME, II.INDEXVALUE, CI.LOWLIMIT, CI.HIGHLIMIT, CI.ITEMNAME FROM T_EMC_CATEGORY_SECTION CS LEFT JOIN T_EMC_INFO_INDEX_CATEGORY IIC ON IIC.ID = CS.INDEXCATEGORYID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_INFO_INDEX II ON II.ID = IIC.INDEXID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_CODE C ON C.CODECATEGORYID = 'infoIndexCategory' AND C.CODE = IIC.CATEGORY LEFT JOIN T_EMC_CATEGORY_INDEX CI ON CI.INDEXCATEGORYID = CS.INDEXCATEGORYID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
